sections.heading: What to do now
list: Gather actual household income records — taxable rental results, savings interest and full event-contract trading records. The person's Kalshi tax character is not established here. See income sources and flags.
Apply for a real determination through DHCS or Covered California. Medi-Cal accepts applications year-round; marketplace enrollment has its own window/SEP.

Assess the work-rule month separately if you are a covered adult beginning January 2027: monthly income must be determined using MAGI-based household methods under §14005.69(e)(6), not gross deposits. Averaging is specified for seasonal workers.
Consider other verified routes and exceptions rather than inventing work hours or medical/seasonal status. See work-rule options and unresolved items.

sections.heading: What this site does and does not do
list: Independent sections were written at different times; older "verified" labels are not a fresh certification. Use the current accuracy update and independent audit when a statement conflicts.
Age, household composition, actual countable income, Kalshi tax characterization and county determination are not given. Do not infer them.
Unconfirmed values are blank where corrected and visible at Flagged for Review. Legacy exceptions are also inventoried on the independent audit.
Research only, not legal/tax/benefits advice; apply through DHCS for a case decision.
